name: task-entity
description: Note-per-task core for the to-do model: every task becomes its own tiny note under spice/tasks/ with `type: task` frontmatter (status/scheduled/due/priority/project/source/created_at/completed_at), and surfaces live-query those notes. Exposes `customJS.TaskEntity` with the pure, side-effect-free core: deterministic `taskFilename` (title+HHmmss hash → collision-resistant name; no Date.now/Math.random), `composeNote` (schema-exact frontmatter, empty-string-not-omitted dates for simple edits), `parseNote` (normalize status→open + blank dates→null), `queryToday` (open-only today/overdue partition), and `validatePayload`. One note per task → a bad write can only touch one task, never a whole day's list; recoverable delete (status: deleted) and backup-first migration follow in later tasks. Foundation for the TaskDialog + TaskTodayList consumers added in subsequent cycle tasks.
